name: Conrad Ranch

items.label: Description
items.value: A reception venue on a historic family-owned homestead with canyon walls, Mount Timpanogos views, spring-fed ponds, a lighted patio, indoor and outdoor spaces, and an on-site coordinator.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
8-hour rental 2pm-10pm with indoor option (house), onsite coordinator or hostess, standard tables, chairs and linens, kitchen access, bridal suite and groom's room, patio with lights, parking
Full day 10am-10pm — add $1,000 to the day rate
100 additional chairs — $2 each
Additional guest table with chairs and linen — $40 each, up to 5
Serving table with linen — $30 each
Linens only — $10-$20
Table setup on the flat area — $200
Catering restock staff — $75 per staff for 2 hours; $25/hour extra

items.label: Deposit
items.value:
$1,000 non-refundable deposit to reserve; transferable within the year with 120 days notice
Ceremony only: $500 non-refundable deposit
Final payment and contract at least 4 weeks before the event; $100 late fee

items.label: Seated
items.value:
85 indoors for a formal dinner
112 with rented tables

items.label: Shaded Tree Area
items.value: Guests: 100+ · Note: fixed iron arch included

items.label: Gazebo
items.value: Guests: 100+ · Note: ceremony under the entrance arch

items.label: House (indoor)
items.value: Seated: 85 formal dinner; 112 with rented tables · Standing: 350+ open house · Setting: indoor · Season: March-November 1

items.label: Grounds, pavilion, gazebo, ponds
items.value: Setting: outdoor · Season: April-October · Note: outdoor tables seat about 7 each; 100 chairs + 100 rentable

items.label: Rain plan
items.value: Option to move inside the house at no extra charge

items.label: Groom's room
items.value: Grooms room is located at the end of the building downstairs

items.label: Event coordinator
items.value: Onsite coordinator to assist with needs and questions

items.label: Included items
items.value:
Outdoor: 9 48-inch round guest tables with linen
Outdoor: 3 iron umbrella tables
8-foot serving table with linen
Cake table with linen
Sign-in table
Display table with linen
Black iron beverage / water table
100 chairs
2 floor easels
White metal gift cart
Fixed iron arch at the Shaded Tree ceremony area
Outdoor lighting
Patio lights
Indoor: 13 round wooden guest tables
Indoor: hardwood dance floor
2 fireplaces
Baby grand piano

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value: Not included; staff set up and take down venue tables and chairs, renters clean up everything they bring and all areas used

items.label: Ceremony arch / backdrop
items.value: Fixed iron arch; backdrop arches for rent

items.label: For rent
items.value:
100 additional chairs — $2 each
Additional guest table with chairs and linen — $40 each, up to 5
Serving table with linen — $30 each
White lantern — $10 each
Wooden lantern — $10 each
Traditional metal lantern — $10 each
Canopy of lights — $300 setup
Love Sign — $100
6 lanterns and hooks — $50
Double Octagon Arch — $100
Wooden Arch — $100
Centerpieces and decorations — ask for pricing

items.label: Extras
items.value:
3 spring-fed ponds and waterfall
Covered pavilion and gazebo
Patio with lights for dancing
Bridal photos on another day by appointment (free with a booked event)
In-house DJ, florist and cake decorator available to hire

items.label: LOVE sign (4 x 8 ft, light sequences)
Cake table
items.value: Cake table with linen to the ground

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Own caterer or own food allowed; food must be pre-cooked and assembled on site
Food trucks allowed in approved areas (not on grass)
Preferred caterer list provided

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
House kitchen for warming and staging only: double fridge, microwave, 2 warming ovens, warming cabinet, small freezer, prep table, counters, knives and cutting boards
Power House building by the pavilion: fridge, freezer, counters, running water
No cooking

items.label: Alcohol
items.value: No alcohol anywhere on the property

items.label: Sparklers allowed
items.value: Sparklers allowed (except during state fire bans)

items.label: Sparklers
items.value: Yes, outside near the house with provided metal buckets (unless a state fire ban applies)

items.label: Times
items.value:
Mon-Wed 2pm-10pm
Thu-Sat 2pm-10pm
Full day 10am-10pm (add $1,000)
Ceremony only 9am-1pm (3-hour block)
Closed Sunday

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No cooking
No glass bottles served to guests
No silk petals, confetti, fireworks, fiber-optic wands or pond decorations
Sparklers only outside in provided metal buckets; cleanup required
Ground stakes need staff approval
Smoking and vaping only in the parking lots
Events end by 10pm (sound ordinance)
No arriving early or staying past rental hours

items.label: Accessibility
items.value:
Handicap accessible
Handicap accessible parking in the upper lot west of the house

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Guest parking lot across the street (cones set out)
Family and handicap parking in the upper lot behind the house

items.label: Notes
items.value:
No Wi-Fi; AT&T has the best cell service
Outdoor events April-October; indoor events March-November 1
DJ: outside DJ or in-house DJ
Only one event at a time

items.label: Contact
items.value:
Linda Conrad: 801-225-6238 (no text)
Jen Walker: (801) 368-3223
Email: conradranch1863@gmail.com

rules.note: Also no silk petals, fireworks or fiber-optic wands
